existing_prospective_evidence.interpretation: Weeks 1-3 are early descriptive evidence under frozen upstream studies and cannot authorize a DB model change.

idp_lineage_isolation_diagnostic.interpretation: The prior DL/LB transport-residual finding is preserved as context but is not transferred to DB absent direct DB evidence.

legacy_production_lineage_diagnostic.interpretation: Legacy DB lineage drift is diagnostic only; it cannot authorize deployment.

next_step_if_green: Review B1 findings. If no material DB calibration concern is established, freeze no-change and close the positional structural-audit series. Kickers are excluded. If a material concern remains, preregister a broad-cohort DB calibration study before fitting or validation.
scientific_limits: This audit can identify mechanical compression, discontinuities, age sensitivity, coverage gaps, statistical outliers, and lineage instability.
It cannot establish the true market price of DB scarcity.
It cannot infer that a specific named DB is too high or too low.
The prior DL/LB transport-residual finding cannot be generalized to DB without direct evidence.
Production V2 Phase 1 is transparent but uncalibrated.
Weeks 1-3 realized outcomes are too early under frozen prospective protocols to select or deploy a DB model change.
No new DB weight, age curve, production transform, youth premium, or player-specific adjustment is fit here.
Kickers are excluded from this audit series.

age_surface.interpretation: Probe surfaces use fixed production anchors only to expose integer-age discontinuities; no anchor is a fitted candidate.

outlier_diagnostics.interpretation: Outlier flags are descriptive review signals only; they do not authorize named-player corrections.
